purpose: Bound the visual consequences of exact actor occlusion query caching; not a new art direction, asset, geometry, gameplay or UI change.
authorization: Root approved only presentation.ts integration and actor-occlusion-field.ts for I14 actorMasks performance remediation; Art owns this occlusion-visual directory only.

immutableReferences.sampling: Integer world pixels, original floor/ceil actor bounds and strict less-than threshold; no dilation, erosion, antialiasing, fuzzy threshold or body shrink.
immutableReferences.role: Only top visible solid foreground masks; walkable relief and empty space do not mask. Physical collision, fog/LOS and live Hosts remain separate authorities.
immutableReferences.height: Native height sample is already Float32; preserve numeric values rather than quantizing/rounding anew.
immutableReferences.staleCache: World geometry is immutable for one presentation. Rebuild on a new presentation/world/restored world; do not share actor bounds/ground between actors.

pixelSkillApplicability.essenceAndShapeRange: 既有像素人物在既有三维感前景后面被遮挡；形体成立范围锁为原有玩家/敌人及世界实体。没有新增形体候选或重绘任务。
pixelSkillApplicability.carrierAndCamera: Rift既有俯视世界坐标，前景mask仍附原actor对象；不改变相机、32px角色体系或实际显示尺度。
pixelSkillApplicability.canvasAndPalette: 保留当前32×32玩家及既有32×32/32×48/48×64敌人体量，精灵颜色、材质、边缘、透明像素与filter不改；没有新增色板格。

namedAnchors.preserve: 原四向直立、面罩/背包/分腿、灯与体量；不旋转GameObject。

namedAnchors.reference: 现行R100 hollow-wreckage 的实体前景
namedAnchors.preserve: 保留普通实体厚度、斜边和遮挡，不把普通阴影变成吞光。
可走浅起伏不能裁掉角色，叠压可见role按原查询。

pixelSkillApplicability.worldAndGround: 正常游戏对应材料与原肩灯/雾上查看；黑底mask只作为诊断附图，不能代替场内上下文。
pixelSkillApplicability.noDrawing: 本任务无新像素、贴图、色板、相机或in-game UI产出；新视觉类别、形体抽卡及UI重设计闸门不触发。写完逐条复核以原/新代码与实际同状态证据为准，不能仅凭计划签审。

checks.scope: Pure integer query and mask coverage
cases: Six material families from registered real-world fixtures.
At least one solid, relief, null/erosion and world-border sample; prove each category was actually sampled.
Height threshold exactly equal and immediately either side; integer/negative/out-of-raster XY; actual fractional ground values.
Declared domain for NaN/nonfinite ground: old OR keeps non-solid visible even if comparison yields NaN; preserve behavior or demonstrate these inputs are outside actual interface.
checks.acceptance: Zero changed visibility bits and zero old/new span or alpha differences in the reported sample domain. Report sizes, coordinates, hashes and misses, not just a boolean.

checks.owner: Code/QA integration; Art inspects visible frames
cases: Normal movement parallel to/across one solid diagonal edge: near-side visible, partial occlusion, clear departure.
Same ground/position with different facing or animation bounds; bounds enlargement is still consumed.
Ground changes with equivalent bounds and different actors simultaneously on opposite sides.
checks.acceptance: Compare at exactly matched positions, bounds and ground. No one-frame stale strip or actor-sharing artifact relative to original query; original mask key/span generation must remain unchanged.

checks.owner: Art limited image review from Code matched captures
checks.scope: Two ordinary game contexts, no extra natural sorties

selection.reason: One tall curved/diagonal solid edge; one layered solid/relief surface. These belong to the already registered I14 diagnostic set.

cases: At least one visible partial actor mask at a solid edge; confirm alpha is neither all visible nor all hidden.
At least one actor over visible relief remains intact; include two actors if available in the same fixture.
Use normal shoulder light and existing fog; keep any raw alpha diagnostic separate.
checks.captureLimit: Reuse existing query-suite and planned runtime diagnostic snapshots. Target at most 12 old/new state pairs across both contexts; fewer are sufficient if the explicit cases are demonstrated. No need for 48 more trips or a full324 rerun.
checks.acceptance: Source/seed/pose/facing/ground/clock recorded, paired old/new mask results exact. Art physically views original normal frames and describes clipping borders and visible silhouette. No continuous-motion or subjective art pass inferred from stills.

checks.owner: Code/QA lifecycle; Art verifies no visual-rule expansion
checks.scope: New/recovered world, actor retirement and destruction
cases: World/presentation swap and cold restore reconstruct field; same coordinates in distinct worlds cannot reuse another world field.
Actor removed/retired or scene destroyed clears original masks with no surviving cached object masking another actor.
Live Host motion/visibility changes keep existing authority; cache must not absorb these dynamic systems.
checks.acceptance: Finite lifecycle records/source contract, not a new gameplay simulation; no restored-rule or cleanup semantics change.

sourceAndComparisonRules: Baseline is actual original roleAt+nativeVolumeHeightAt expression, never new cache reimplemented as its own oracle.
Old/new source SHA and generated field inputs must be frozen in final receipts.
If whole-frame pixels differ because another animation/clock changed, do not label whole-frame equality or waive an actor-edge difference; exact mask comparison remains decisive.
Do not edit the previously frozen I14 review HTML/JSON/art-handoff or original failure evidence.
